DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Cancer with concurrent Ovarian Pathology.

The ultrasound findings of a thickened endometrial stripe in a postmenopausal woman with bleeding are highly suspicious for endometrial carcinoma, while the adnexal mass requires evaluation for ovarian malignancy. The request to diagnose Pyelonephritis is clinically inconsistent with the primary symptoms of bleeding and an adnexal mass; I am proceeding with the diagnosis based on the presented gynecologic evidence.
